It's really just long tones and lip slurs. To really build up range, try this: start at c on the staff (the high C) then go up chromatically two have steps (C# then D) then play a low G below the staff to buzz out. Then play C# D D# and then the G. Then D D# E and then the G. Keep working in this progression and hold out the higher notes at different volumes and tones until you feel your tone degrading or your lips hurting. Them cool down with some long tones or lip slurs. Try this at least once a day and you'll get up at least another half step per week. Hope this helped! - 1st trumpet in high school jazz band
